note: Gzipped+minified byte budgets for the package's own contribution to a consumer bundle. Measured by scripts/check-bundle-size.mts: each entry is bundled from dist/ with esbuild (--bundle --minify --format=esm --platform=browser), the optional peer dependencies are marked external (they are the host's responsibility), and the output is gzipped. CI (.github/workflows/ci.yml `size` job) fails if any measured value exceeds its budget. Bump a budget deliberately — with `npm run size:update` — only when an intentional change grows an entry; an accidental regression on the core value prop should redden the PR instead. Budgets carry ~5% headroom over the measured size so trivial refactors don't force a bump.
